purpose: Local account research and message drafts; no campaign enrollment or sending.

scoring.note: Analyst judgments about outreach priority, not measured market size, revenue or probabilities.

targets.target_role: Head of payments or eSIM partnerships
targets.evidence: Terms document a crypto surcharge and support-assisted underpayments.
targets.pain_hypothesis: A small refill pilot may reduce payment exceptions; current costs and failure rates require discovery.
targets.integration: Hosted checkout plus a custom webhook that credits one refill exactly once.
targets.qualification: Confirm surcharge scope, provider contract, smallest economical refill, refund handling and telecom eligibility. Retain country and identity rules.
targets.disqualifier: No payment exceptions, no interest in another rail, or no compatible refill API.
targets.subject: A crypto-refill pilot for Keepgo
targets.message:
Hi Keepgo team,

Your payment docs already cover crypto refills. I run CoinPay at Profullstack. Would a small pilot connecting hosted crypto checkout to one refill SKU help your payments team compare exception handling and total cost? We would preserve your existing account and country checks and measure successful refill delivery, not just a transaction hash.

Worth a short workflow review?

Anthony | Profullstack
